items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: My aunt Laura, she could play the piano by music.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I see. No. No, I think I got it straight. It's very complicated.

He had a, Adam had a sister named Velma. She could play. My aunt played good music. You know, play music. My aunt Laura, she could play the piano by music. Yeah. Only by music. Yeah. They learn it in the Catholic schools. I see. Yeah. Very interesting. All of them learn it in the Catholic schools. Yeah. They meant you learn how to read the notes on the blackboard. Yeah. That's right. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Yeah. But Adam, he's down in San Diego. He's here. And you, you... He's playing every night.
Some, some, some, some, all of them. Yeah.
